name: duopore-public-work-capacity-worksheet
description: Check whether a new piece of work fits into the hours you have available.
keywords: check if more work will fit

interface.shortDescription: Check if more work will fit
interface.longDescription: Check whether a new piece of work fits into the hours you have available. Enter your weekly hours, time set aside for other duties, the number of weeks, and current and new work hours. See spare time or the size of an overload. The app checks the hours you enter; it does not assign work or measure how fast you work.
capabilities: Check if more work will fit
defaultPrompt: Will this new project fit into my available hours?
Show how many work hours I have left after current jobs.
